_comment: Generated by tools/build_food_profiles.py from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy). Values per 100 g: calories in kcal, macros and fiber in g, vitamins and minerals in mg or mcg (see nutrients.json), the B vitamins in % of the FDA Daily Value. Edit tools/data/food_sources.json and re-run rather than editing by hand.
